subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit opt-in `agent.request` media relay contract for Node-originated attachments, or should visible media delivery remain controlled by direct send and agent-authored reply/message-tool payloads?
rationale: The request is useful, but it changes who may move Node-supplied media across credentialed IM delivery, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Design explicit opt-in relay
options.body: Add the feature only after defining authorization, target scoping, media limits, audit behavior, and agent override or suppression semantics.

options.title: Keep agent-controlled delivery
options.body: Leave request attachments as model input and require Node callers to use direct send, message-tool media, or an agent-authored media reply for visible chat delivery.

options.title: Defer pending gateway media design
options.body: Keep this issue open as a design item until broader Gateway media relay and security semantics are ready.

recommendation.title: Design explicit opt-in relay
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after defining authorization, target scoping, media limits, audit behavior, and agent override or suppression semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a gateway/media security-boundary product decision, and this is the strongest available routing candidate from recent area history and current central-file ownership signals.
